searchText: Finally got slashed So what happens to a validator once it get's slashed? Does it get to keep participating? The beaconcha.in page says "Exit on: Epoch 257" so it's done? <@372731338031366165> Once you are slashed you are removed from the active validator pool. you will slowly lose balance until you can withdraw i think like 30days(?) Says: `in 1 mth (Epoch 8444)` So I was slashed, lost 1 ETH, now I'll loose more ETH over the next month? yep huh, I would think that by having exited, that would stop the loss, but I haven't payed that close attention to the details. Good to know...what happens after a month? Assuming I *COULD* withdraw? yes , https://www.attestant.io/posts/understanding-the-validator-lifecycle/ So once I hit the withdrawable state, the bleeding stops? Even if I don't withdraw? correct Thanks for the lesson 🙂 its like voluntarily exiting + losing money and longer waiting times makes attacks less predictable Withdrawable is safe. Anything before that you can still be fined. I think it's meant to hurt if you get slashed A slow, painful death 🔪 ☠️
